goal.text: Standalone, composable Claude Code skills you install once to make Claude better at recurring work.

successCriteria.text: Each skill triggers when relevant: every SKILL.md loads and passes the official validator.
Each skill works on its own on Linux, Windows and macOS, Python 3.9+.
Skills cost little context: descriptions stay inside the 1,400-token budget.
Triggering is measured, not assumed: trigger tests run for every skill.

session.stopReason: Nothing left worth doing; the remaining candidates were picked by 0 of 3 panel members.

decisions.title: Crowded trigger tests with 45 filler skills
decisions.winning: Separates crowding from shadowing with no credentials or owner files touched.
decisions.dissent: Small, synthetic sample: record as-is and change no description.

decisions.title: Find duplicate and stale skills
decisions.winning: Users see the wrong copy fire and can't tell why; the check proves it and prints the fix.
decisions.dissent: claude.ai org skills can't be removed by claude plugin; named as not checked.

decisions.title: Install steps in every skill README
decisions.winning: A user landing on a skill's README got stuck at step one.
decisions.dissent: Keep it a line, not a project.

veto.reason: Plugin icons are brand artwork the owner must choose; not automated.

decisions.title: Shorter descriptions for four skills
decisions.winning: Users pay for descriptions every session; before/after trigger tests prove nothing was lost.
decisions.dissent: Sandboxed evals can't see duplicate installed copies; memory and schema-aware-db left alone.

decisions.title: Trigger tests for every skill
decisions.winning: The only proof that skills trigger when relevant.
decisions.dissent: Keep it cheap: a capped local command.

decisions.title: Professional review every session
decisions.winning: Evidence plus 'checked' records make each session auditable.
decisions.dissent: The same generic gaps would repeat; known gaps are now only re-raised if worse.

decisions.title: The product page is always current
decisions.winning: A hook that writes after Claude stops leaves unreported changes; this one only asks Claude to re-render.
decisions.dissent: A hook can't fix 'the agent never updated the data'; the per-change rule does.

veto.reason: Vetoed any hook that writes on its own. Logged in complete auto; the chosen hook never writes.

decisions.title: Product page and website improvements
decisions.winning: Every addition is a textContent element, so the existing safety tests still hold.
decisions.dissent: Keep dissent visible; the real website bug was a hand-kept skill list missing git-conventions.

decisions.title: New skill: git-conventions
decisions.winning: The native attribution setting is the deterministic part; a commit hook would miss Claude's usual heredoc commits.
decisions.dissent: Instructions drift when the skill isn't loaded mid-task.

decisions.title: Two skills never loaded; validate in CI
decisions.winning: codebase-guardian was installed but missing from the session's skills.
decisions.dissent: Delete the root plugin.json instead of renaming it.

decisions.title: test-report records video of failing tests
decisions.winning: Recordings can capture credentials and personal data, so keep them local and record only failures.
decisions.dissent: Local-only links are dead for reviewers.

veto.reason: Committing recordings would put secrets in public history. Logged in complete-auto mode; the chosen option never commits them.

decisions.title: README explains how to update plugins
decisions.winning: The owner's own install sat on 1.5.0 after 1.6.0 shipped.
decisions.dissent: Check the command against the real CLI first (done).

decisions.title: lsp docs work on macOS and Linux
decisions.winning: Stock macOS and Ubuntu have no python, so the documented command failed.
decisions.dissent: Ship the owner's video request first.
